summary.text: Ann Johnson is a Democratic state representative and attorney who has represented Texas House District 134 since January 2021 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Her professional experience includes working as a human trafficking prosecutor and a teacher.

paragraphs.text: Ann Johnson was born in Houston, Texas.
She earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Texas in 1988 and a law degree from South Texas College of Law in 2001.
Her professional experience includes working as a human trafficking prosecutor, a teacher, a small business owner and an attorney.
She has been affiliated with the State Bar of Texas, the Houston LGBTQ Political Caucus, Meyerland Area Democrats Club, Bayou Blue Democrats and St. Paul's United Methodist Church.
Johnson defeated incumbent Sarah Davis in the November 3, 2020 general election and assumed office on January 12, 2021.
In the 2023-2024 session she was vice chair of the Insurance Committee and vice chair of the General Investigating Committee, and also served on the Calendars and Public Health committees.
She defeated Audrey Douglas in the November 5, 2024 general election and advanced from the March 3, 2026 Democratic primary; Mike Michna is the Republican candidate in 2026.
